integrity: Analytical proof and independently executable finite rational diagnostics are provided. Claims of authorship, publication priority, external certification, or independent audit are not made.
scientific_limitations: The exact theorem concerns the unweighted shortest-path metric on the vertex set of a balanced two-hub tree with \(q\ge1\) leaves per hub. Weighted, unbalanced, and continuous-edge versions are not classified. The finite verifier is corroborative, not a proof of all-parameter statements. A prior unindexed equivalent formula is not ruled out.
title: Exact generalized roundness and critical Hilbert dimension of balanced double-star trees
